SELECT sd.*, ARRAY_AGG(sr.role_name) AS roleNames FROM sys_dept sd LEFT JOIN sys_role_dept srd ON srd.dept_id = sd."id" LEFT JOIN sys_role sr ON srd.role_id = sr."id"
and sd.parent_id=#{req.parentId}
and sd.status=#{req.status}
and sd.dept_name like concat('%', #{req.deptName}::text, '%')
and sd.dept_code like concat('%', #{req.deptCode}::text, '%')
and sd.deleted = false
GROUP BY sd.id

SELECT id, dept_name, dept_code, parent_id, leader, phone, email, sort_order, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted, version FROM sys_dept WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted = false ORDER BY sort_order

WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( -- 基础查询：查询当前部门 SELECT id, parent_id FROM sys_dept WHERE id = #{deptId}::bigint AND deleted = false
UNION ALL
-- 递归查询：查询所有子部门 SELECT d.id, d.parent_id FROM sys_dept d INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON d.parent_id = dt.id WHERE d.deleted = false ) SELECT id::text FROM dept_tree ORDER BY id
